Strategy: Modulo-three switch: items divisible by three use tightest fit, items with remainder one use worst fit, and items with remainder two target a bin leaving exactly one item-sized gap; the residue class routes each item to a different packing mode, separating size classes into different bin pools. It can fail when residue classes carry no size signal and the split only fragments the bin pool.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) if item % 3 == 0 else (r if item % 3 == 1 else -abs(r - 2 * item))) for r in bins]
```
